tasks.label: clean
tasks.detail: Removes build/ entirely, including CMakeCache.txt -- needed when switching this checkout between host and container (CMake's cache pins an absolute source path) or to force a full reconfigure. cmake --build build --target clean only clears build artifacts, not the cache, so it won't fix a path mismatch.

tasks.label: format-check
tasks.detail: Dry-run clang-format check, scoped to CMakeLists.txt's fixed file list -- never reformats the tree.

tasks.label: gates
tasks.detail: Builds a throwaway dev-container image and runs AGENTS.md's full gate list inside it -- the same command CI's checks are derived from. Independent of whether you're already working in the devcontainer.
